member.name: F:K4WorldTextSharedAPI.TextLine.FontName
member.summary:
Font family name. Truncated to 64 UTF-8 bytes, the size of the entity's font-name field. Rendering happens on each client, and the client resolves the name through the game's own fontconfig setup, so an unknown name falls back to a default sans-serif face instead of failing.
Faces shipped with CS2 (game/csgo/panorama/fonts/). Stratum2 faces are named exactly as in the game's panorama fonts.css:
Stratum2, Stratum2 Thin, Stratum2 Light, Stratum2 Medium, Stratum2 Black
Stratum2 Thin Italic, Stratum2 Light Italic, Stratum2 Medium Italic, Stratum2 Black Italic
Stratum2 Condensed, Stratum2 Thin Condensed, Stratum2 Light Condensed, Stratum2 Medium Condensed, Stratum2 Bold Condensed, Stratum2 Black Condensed
Stratum2 TF, Stratum2 Thin TF, Stratum2 Light TF, Stratum2 Medium TF, Stratum2 Bold TF, Stratum2 Black TF (tabular figures)
Stratum2 Mono, Stratum2 Mono Light, Stratum2 Regular Monodigit, Stratum2 Bold Monodigit
Noto Sans, Noto Sans Bold, Noto Sans Italic, Noto Sans Bold Italic
Noto Serif, Noto Serif Bold, Noto Serif Italic, Noto Serif Bold Italic
Noto Mono, Noto Sans Symbols
Noto Sans JP, Noto Sans KR, Noto Sans SC, Noto Sans TC, Noto Sans Thai, each also as ... Light and ... Bold
The game's own CSS selects regular Stratum2 bold and italic through font weight and style, which point_worldtext has no field for, so use one of the named faces above for those.
Arial, Arial Bold, Tahoma, Verdana, and Courier New are not shipped: the game loads them from the client's OS font directory, so they render only on clients that have them installed (Windows by default; Linux and macOS clients get a fontconfig substitute).

member.name: M:K4WorldTextSharedAPI.IK4WorldTextProvider.ForPlugin(CounterStrikeSharp.API.Core.IPlugin)
member.summary: Returns the text API scoped to . Every text created through the returned instance belongs to that plugin: its id is unknown to every other scope, and on it removes only those texts. Scopes are keyed by , so repeated calls from the same plugin return the same scope, also after that plugin hot reloads. Safe to call from any thread.

member.name: T:K4WorldTextSharedAPI.IK4WorldTextSharedAPI
member.summary:
Text API bound to one owning plugin; obtain it from . An id is only valid on the scope that issued it. Every id-taking method treats an id issued to another plugin exactly like an unknown id.
Every method except is safe to call from any thread. Arguments are validated synchronously on the calling thread. From the game thread the entity work runs before the call returns; from any other thread it is queued with Server.NextWorldUpdate and runs in call order, and the returned id is valid right away. Failures inside the entity work never reach the caller: the plugin rolls back, logs, keeps the id tracked, and retries the spawn on the next round start.
Every id becomes invalid on map end and when this plugin unloads or reloads. Re-create texts from your own map-start handling.
